title: ASR Probe Record (probes.jsonl line)
description: One execution of the verification gate against one access method — the evidence behind the hard promise. Probe records are append-only (probes.jsonl beside the profile); their evidence[] entries name files under evidence/ whose bytes must hash-match sha256 (probe_evidence_hash_mismatch). Recorded URLs and headers are secret-REDACTED before writing: a probe record proves reachability, it never leaks a credential.

probed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC with millisecond precision (feeds identity).

method.description: tool for real probes; fixture for deterministic example builders (fixtures never lie, but they say what they are).

checks.description: The individual verification steps, in execution order. A skipped check is recorded with result skip and a detail — skips are visible, never silently dropped.

url.description: The request URL with any credential value replaced by *** BEFORE recording.

headers_subset.description: Selected response headers (server, retry-after, rate-limit family, deprecation); never set-cookie or anything bearing tokens.

evidence.description: Stored artifacts proving what the probe saw. sha256 is the hash of the stored bytes exactly (the recomputable claim); for truncated body samples, full_sha256/full_bytes describe the complete body when known.

path.description: Registry-relative path under the source's evidence/ directory.

truncated_at.description: Byte cap applied, when the stored sample is a prefix; null when complete.

credential.description: Which credential ref was involved and which chain step resolved it — never the value.
